info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 研究語言如何在實際的社會條件下和各種語境中被使用的學科。語言中諸多原理原則受到何等社會條件的左右？?何男和女人的話就是不同？?何各地有方言的產生？?何各行各業都有行話？這都是社會語言學要探討的。
description.describe_eh: Sociolinguistics is the descriptive study of what impact social factors have on language. While better-known branches like phonetics, semantics and pragmatics focus on how language works in a vacuum, sociolinguistics tends to approach language use from a societal perspective, placing it in actual social contexts. In short, it is a scientific enterprise that is capable of describing what people say in a particular social context, while attempting to provide justification for it.

textBooks.tpb_book: Peter Trudgill, Sociolinguistics: An Introduction to Language and Society, Penguin, 1995

readings.tpc_book: Robert Bayley (eds.), The Oxford Handbook of Sociolinguistics, Oxford University Press

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: In-class participation 20%; Presentation 1 40%; Presentation 2 40%. 課堂參與 兩次報告
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
In-class participation expected and appreciated.
Attendance will not be made mandatory...but it will be encouraged appreciated.
Physical appearance does not amount to in-class participation.
An exclusive LINE group for this seminar will be created, and everyone is expected to raise questions and leave remarks there.
No food or drinks during sessions. 
Drinking water will be fine.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Conducted in English (EMI).
In-class participation and attendance will account for 20% of your final grade.
The first assignment, which will take the form of a skit, will account for 40% of it.
Finally, the final group presentation, which will take the form of a booth presentation at a mock conference, will account for the remaining 40%.
There will be NO written tests!
Please join our class LINE group, where we share all information.
Please feel free to raise all your concerns with me by email or on LINE.
All are welcome...especially international students!
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
Students are always encouraged to participate actively by sharing their views and input.
Join in with a light heart but an industrious attitude.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Please try not to be late.
Please try not to miss and session.
Please no eating and drinking in class.
It will be a fun course...a venue where everybody gets to express their views and share them with everybody else.
Most importantly, there will be generous cash prizes handed out by me to the most hard-working ones of you.
All are welcome..especially international students!
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
In one word, plagiarism will not be tolerated.
Any allegations of plagiarism will be pursued to the fullest extent.
In an effort to demostrate the significance of academic integrity to students, I will give my students a one-hour presentation on it in one of the first three sessions of the semester. 
Academic integrity is the expectation that teachers, students, researchers and all members of the academic community will act with honesty, trust, fairness, respect and responsibility.
Breaching academic integrity is also known as ‘academic misconduct’ or ‘academic dishonesty’.
All students are expected to uphold academic integrity during their studies. An important way of upholding their academic integrity is by contacting their teacher/instructor or their department/university if they are having study problems and working with them for a solution. 
Studying and learning provides the knowledge expected of a student in this course, but any form of cheating/plagiarism means that they could miss important professional knowledge and practice that they will need for success in their future career.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
All are welcome...especially international students!
Conducted in English.
This will be a very useful and interesting course, where you come into contact with all sorts of different nations, jurisdictions and regimes and how to deal with them.
There will be generous cash prizes handed out by the instructor for the best assignments and the best presentations.
Most of all, there will be NO tests.
This will for sure be a rare opportunity.
So...what are you waiting for?
Come on and join us.
However, that said...
No plagiarism allowed.
